title: Counter the Wrath of God that kills three of your creatures
briefing: P2 casts Wrath of God with P1 controlling Serra Angel, Kalonian Tusker and Grizzly Bears and P2 only a Wall of Omens. P1 has two Islands open, Negate and Essence Scatter; only Negate can answer a noncreature spell.

reference.analysis: Wrath kills three of P1's creatures to one of P2's. Negate counters it; Essence Scatter cannot target a noncreature spell, so it is not offered.

options.label: Negate Wrath of God
options.why: Saves three creatures for one card.

otherwise.why: Wrath resolves and P1 loses its board.
